items.source: Configures the name to a KeySpaceStore bean to be used as database for all keyspaces.
items.translation: 将名称配置为用作所有键空间数据库的 KeySpaceStore Bean。

items.source: Configures the name of the KeyValueOperations bean to be used with the repositories detected.
items.translation: 配置与检测到的仓库一起使用的 `KeyValueOperations` Bean 的名称。

items.source: Configure a specific BeanNameGenerator to be used when creating the repository beans.
items.translation: 配置一个特定的BeanNameGenerator，以便在创建存储库 Bean 时使用。

items.source: Configures the accessor for sorting results.
items.translation: 配置用于对结果进行排序的accessor。

items.source:
Configures whether nested repository-interfaces (e.g. defined as inner classes) should be discovered by the
repositories infrastructure.
items.translation: 配置是否由仓库基础设施发现嵌套的仓库接口（例如定义为内部类的接口）。

items.source: Specifies which types are not eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定不适用于组件扫描的类型。

items.source: Configures the location of where to find the Spring Data named queries properties file.
items.translation: 配置查找 Spring Data 命名查询属性文件的位置。

items.source: Configure the repository base class to be used to create repository proxies for this particular configuration.
items.translation: 配置用于为当前特定配置创建存储库代理的存储库基类。

items.source: Copyright © 2011–2026 Pivotal Software, Inc.. All rights reserved.
items.translation: 版权所有 © 2011–2026 Pivotal Software, Inc.。保留所有权利。

items.source: Configures the Map structure used for data storage. Defaults to ConcurrentHashMap. Will be ignored in case an explicit bean for the KeyValueTemplate is available in the ApplicationContext or keySpaceStoreRef() is configured.
items.translation: 配置用于数据存储的 Map 结构。默认值为 ConcurrentHashMap。如果 KeyValueTemplate 的显式 Bean 存在于 ApplicationContext 中，或者已配置了 keySpaceStoreRef()，则该设置将被忽略。

items.source: Annotation to activate Map repositories. If no base package is configured through either value(), basePackages() or basePackageClasses() it will trigger scanning of the package of annotated class.
items.translation: 用于激活 Map 存储库的注解。如果未通过 value()、basePackages() 或 basePackageClasses() 配置基础包，它将触发对已注解类所在包的扫描。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute. Allows for more concise annotation declarations e.g.: @EnableJpaRepositories("org.my.pkg") instead of @EnableJpaRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg").
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。允许使用更简洁的注解声明，例如：使用 `@EnableJpaRepositories("org.my.pkg")` 代替 `@EnableJpaRepositories(basePackages="org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Base packages to scan for annotated components. value() is an alias for (and mutually exclusive with) this attribute. Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 用于扫描已注解组件的基础包。value() 是该属性的别名，且与其互斥。请使用 basePackageClasses() 作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Returns the key of the QueryLookupStrategy to be used for lookup queries for query methods. Defaults to QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND.
items.translation: 返回用于查询方法查找查询的 QueryLookupStrategy 的键。默认值为 QueryLookupStrategy.Key.CREATE_IF_NOT_FOUND。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance. Defaults to KeyValueRepositoryFactoryBean.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。默认值为 KeyValueRepositoryFactoryBean。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找已注解组件的包的安全类型替代方案，替代basePackages()。

items.source: Configures the Map structure used for data storage.
items.translation: 配置用于数据存储的 Map 结构。

items.source: Configures the QueryEngineFactory to create the QueryEngine.
items.translation: 配置 QueryEngineFactory 以创建 QueryEngine。

items.source: Returns the key of the QueryLookupStrategy to be used for lookup queries for query methods.
items.translation: 返回用于查询方法查找查询的QueryLookupStrategy的键。

items.source: Returns the FactoryBean class to be used for each repository instance.
items.translation: 返回用于每个存储库实例的 FactoryBean 类。

items.source: Alias for the basePackages() attribute.
items.translation: `basePackages()` 属性的别名。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for annotated components. The package of each class specified will be scanned. Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 这是指定用于扫描已注解组件的包的安全类型替代方案 basePackages()。将扫描每个指定类的包。建议为每个包创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning. Further narrows the set of candidate components from everything in basePackages() to everything in the base packages that matches the given filter or filters.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型有资格进行组件扫描。进一步缩小候选组件的范围，从 `basePackages()` 中所有内容筛选为与给定过滤器或过滤器匹配的基础包中的所有内容。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations. Defaults to Impl. So for a repository named PersonRepository the corresponding implementation class will be looked up scanning for PersonRepositoryImpl.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀，默认为"Impl"。因此，对于名为 `PersonRepository` 的仓库，系统将扫描以查找对应的实现类 `PersonRepositoryImpl`。

items.source: Configures the QueryEngineFactory to create the QueryEngine. When both, the query engine and sort accessors are configured, the query engine is instantiated using the configured sort accessor.
items.translation: 配置 QueryEngineFactory 以创建 QueryEngine。当同时配置了查询引擎和排序访问器时，将使用配置的排序访问器来实例化查询引擎。

items.source: Configures the QueryCreator to create Part-Tree queries. The QueryCreator must create queries supported by the underlying QueryEngine.
items.translation: 配置QueryCreator以创建部分树查询。该查询创建器必须生成底层QueryEngine所支持的查询。

items.source: Configures the QueryCreator to create Part-Tree queries.
items.translation: 配置 `QueryCreator` 以生成部分树查询。

items.source: Base packages to scan for annotated components.
items.translation: 用于扫描已注解组件的基础包。

items.source: Specifies which types are eligible for component scanning.
items.translation: 指定哪些类型有资格进行组件扫描。

items.source: Returns the postfix to be used when looking up custom repository implementations.
items.translation: 返回用于查找自定义仓库实现的后缀。

items.source: the BeanNameGenerator to be used or the base BeanNameGenerator interface to indicate context default.
items.translation: 使用BeanNameGenerator，或使用基础的BeanNameGenerator接口以指示上下文默认值。

items.source: QueryEngineFactory to configure the QueryEngine.
items.translation: 通过 QueryEngineFactory 配置查询引擎。

items.source: the configured SortAccessor.
items.translation: 配置的SortAccessor。
